lines: 第一章青楼“我没死？”
柳无邪是被疼醒的，身上压着几块碎木头，让他喘不上气来。
接着，一团凌乱的记忆，钻入他的脑海。
他本是凌云仙界十大仙帝之一，机缘巧合，拾到太荒神器《吞天神鼎》，遭整个仙界围攻，命丧断魂崖。
最后一刻，施展血魔解体术，跟他们同归于尽，炸碎了吞天神鼎，醒来的时候，已经到了这里。
“真武大陆……徐家……上门女婿……败家子……”
脑海中出现的记忆告诉他，他已经不在凌云仙界，而是重生一个叫真武大陆的位面。
而这个少年的身体同样也叫柳无邪，出生富贵人家，五岁时家道变故，父母离奇失踪，造成他从小就性格狭隘、孤僻。
被父亲好友、未来的岳父徐义林收养后，也未见好转。
随着年龄的增长，性格越来越乖张跋扈，甚至认为对他视如己出的岳父图谋他得家业才收养他，疯狂败家瞎混，成为沧澜城有名的败家子。
整个徐家，无一不用废物、蛀虫、垃圾来形容他，依旧我行我素。
转眼到了成亲年纪，岳父徐义林认为结了婚之后，性格也许会收敛。
而今天，就是他的大婚之日。
按理说，他这样的垃圾不可能配得上徐家大小姐。
那是因为柳无邪的父母跟徐义林乃生死之交，两家早已指腹为婚，约定年满十八，即可完婚。
大婚之日，进入洞房后被徐家大小姐打出，在几名狐朋好友唆使下，第一次踏入青楼，突然狂性大发，引燃火烛，导致整个青楼塌陷，悲剧的他，被埋在废墟下面。
挪开压在身上的碎木，平躺在地面上，开始检查身体。
“好狠的手段，一掌命中心脉，如果不是我附身过来，必死无疑，到底是谁想要杀他，布下这样一个局。”
除了一些砸伤之外，最致命来自胸口一道诡异的掌印，他清楚的记得，当时跟几个狐朋狗友一起喝酒，失控后的记忆完全记不起来了。
断开的心脉只是暂时压制住，需要寻找护脉丹药，重新续接，以他的手段，炼制这种丹药不难。
“还好，这是一座修行者大陆，武道极其昌盛……”
武者有诸多等级，分为后天、先天、洗灵、洗髓、真丹……
“这糟糕的身体，用废物来形容都抬举他了。”
筋脉细如发丝，杂质造成的拥堵，只能用惨不忍睹来形容。
“有些麻烦了，我所有的修炼法决，皆为仙界神级功法，真武大陆不过凡界位面，我必须要改修凡界武者的功法才可以。”
打个比方，就好比一个婴儿，身旁虽然摆放着神兵利器，以婴儿的力气，根本无法拿起这些神兵。
想要拿起神兵，必须要成长到一定的程度才可以，至少要达到洗髓境。
尴尬！
柳无邪感觉自己尬的要死，尝试好几次，每次都无功而返，筋脉传来的撕裂感，让他痛不欲生，在修炼下去，肉身必定四分五裂。
这时！
一滴精纯的液体，从他丹田之中流出，冲向筋脉，流入四肢百骸。
羸弱的经脉，犹如贪婪的馋虫，疯狂的吞噬液体，里面的淤泥，一点点溶解，浑身舒泰。
“什么情况？”
神识沉入丹田，查看究竟，这一滴液体是怎么回事？从何而来。
进入丹田的那一刻，脑袋差点炸开，一尊漆黑的神鼎，盘踞丹田中央位置，液体正是从神鼎之中流出。
“这是……这是吞天神鼎，它竟然跟我一起过来了。”
吞天神鼎最后时刻跟他一起炸开，却没想到，出现在他丹田里面。
“难道说……我能重生，跟吞天神鼎有密不可分的关系……”
突然间！
一股庞大的黑色气体，从鼎中冲出，击中柳无邪的意识。
黑色气体不断的翻腾变化，最后化为一道道漆黑的文字，古老且沧桑，充满岁月的痕迹，

Chapter 1 Brothel "Am I not dead?"
Liu Wuxie woke up from the pain. There were several broken pieces of wood on his body, making him unable to breathe.
Then, a mess of memories entered his mind.
He was originally one of the ten immortal emperors in the Lingyun Immortal Realm. By chance, he picked up the Taihuang artifact "The Heaven-Swallowing Divine Cauldron" and was besieged by the entire Immortal Realm. He died at Duanhun Cliff.
At the last moment, he used the Blood Demon Disintegration Technique, died with them, and exploded the Heaven-Swallowing Divine Cauldron. When he woke up, he was already here.
"Zhenwu Continent...Xu family...son-in-law...prodigal son..."
The memory that appeared in his mind told him that he was no longer in Lingyun Immortal World, but was reborn in a plane called Zhenwu Continent.
The body of this boy is also named Liu Wuxie. He was born into a wealthy family. When he was five years old, his family circumstances changed and his parents disappeared mysteriously, which caused him to have a narrow and withdrawn personality since he was a child.
Even after being adopted by Xu Yilin, his father's friend and future father-in-law, things didn't get better.
As he grew older, his personality became more and more arrogant and domineering. He even adopted him because he thought his father-in-law, who treated him as his own, was trying to gain his family fortune. He became a crazy prodigal and became a famous prodigal son in Canglan City.
The entire Xu family used to describe him as waste, moth, and garbage, and they still went their own way.
Now that we are getting married, my father-in-law, Xu Yilin, thinks that after getting married, his personality may become more restrained.
And today is his wedding day.
It stands to reason that a piece of trash like him cannot be worthy of the eldest daughter of the Xu family.
That's because Liu Wuxie's parents and Xu Yilin are life-and-death friends. The two families have already been married by marriage, and they agreed that the marriage can be consummated when they reach eighteen years old.
On his wedding day, he was beaten by the eldest daughter of the Xu family after entering the bridal chamber. Under the instigation of several fox friends, he entered the brothel for the first time. He suddenly became mad and ignited the candles, causing the entire brothel to collapse. Tragically, he was buried under the ruins.
He moved away the pieces of wood that were pressing on him, lay flat on the ground, and began to examine his body.
"What a ruthless method. One palm of the heart. If I hadn't possessed him, he would have died. Who wanted to kill him and set up such a trap?"
In addition to some bruises, the most fatal thing came from a strange palm mark on his chest. He clearly remembered that he was drinking with a few gangster friends at that time, and he could not remember the memory after losing control.
The disconnected heart vein is only temporarily suppressed, and it is necessary to find a pulse-protecting elixir and reconnect it. With his method, it is not difficult to refine this elixir.
"Fortunately, this is a land of practitioners, and martial arts is extremely prosperous..."
There are many levels of warriors, divided into acquired, innate, spirit-cleansing, marrow-cleansing, true elixir...
"This terrible body, to describe him as trash would be an exaggeration."
The tendons and veins are as thin as hair, and the congestion caused by impurities can only be described as horrific.
"It's a little troublesome. All my cultivation techniques are all god-level techniques in the immortal world. Zhenwu Continent is not in the mortal plane. I have to modify the techniques of warriors in the mortal world."
For example, it is like a baby. Although there are magical weapons beside him, the baby's strength cannot pick up these magical weapons at all.
If you want to pick up the magic weapon, you must grow to a certain level, at least to reach the marrow cleansing state.
Awkward!
Liu Wuxie felt that he was dying of embarrassment. He tried several times, but failed every time. The tearing sensation from his muscles and veins made him miserable. If he continued to practice, his physical body would definitely fall into pieces.
At this time!
A drop of pure liquid flowed out from his Dantian, rushed to the tendons, and flowed into the limbs and bones.
The weak meridians are like greedy insects, devouring the liquid crazily, and the sludge inside dissolves little by little, making the whole body feel comfortable.
"What's going on?"
His consciousness sank into his Dantian to see what was going on with this drop of liquid. Where does it come from.
The moment he entered his dantian, his head almost exploded. A dark divine cauldron occupied the center of his dantian, and the liquid flowed out of the divine cauldron.
"This is...this is the Heaven-Swallowing Divine Cauldron, and it actually came with me."
The Heaven-Swallowing Divine Cauldron exploded with him at the last moment, but unexpectedly, it appeared in his Dantian.
"Could it be that...my ability to be reborn is closely related to the Heaven-Swallowing Divine Cauldron..."
suddenly!
A huge black gas rushed out of the cauldron and hit Liu Wuxie's consciousness.
The black gas keeps churning and changing, and finally turns into a series of dark words, ancient and vicissitudes, full of traces of time,
